jobs.title: Environmental Chemist (Corvallis, OR)
jobs.description:
Description

Environmental Chemist

Put your analytical skills toward making a positive impact on the planet and your career! Join ICF in support of the US Environmental Protection Agency (USEPA) contract at the new Region 9 Laboratory in Corvallis, Oregon.

ICF is looking for an Environmental Chemist in support of the USEPA Region 9 Environmental Services Assistance Team (ESAT) contract. ESAT provides analytical, quality assurance (QA), and technical support to USEPA programs such as such as Drinking Water, Clean Water Act (CWA), Clean Air Act (CAA), and Superfund (CERCLA) programs requiring the identification, assessment, remediation, and regulation of environmental hazards. The team performs analysis on soil, water, air, waste, and tissue samples for chemical contaminants using USEPA-approved methods to support EPA’s mission to protect human health and the environment through programs such as the Drinking Water programs, Clean Water Act (CWA), Clean Air Act (CAA), Superfund (CERCLA).

The Environmental Chemist will apply their knowledge and work experience to primarily support the preparation and analysis of samples using inorganic chemistry methods with possible cross-training on various organic analyses. All team activities must comply with EPA methods for various media (air, water, soil, biota) and environmental programs as well as the NELAC standard (2016). Job duties include sample preparation (primarily acid digestion) and operation of ICP-OES, ICP-MS, and other instrumentation to determine metals and other inorganic contaminants. The successful candidate must be able to work both independently and as member of a team.

The Environmental Chemist
will apply their knowledge and work experience to primarily support the preparation and analysis of samples using inorganic chemistry methods with possible cross-training on various organic analyses. All team activities must comply with EPA methods for various media (air, water, soil, biota) and environmental programs as well as the NELAC standard (2016). Job duties include sample preparation (primarily acid digestion) and operation of ICP-OES, ICP-MS, and other instrumentation to determine metals and other inorganic contaminants. The successful candidate must be able to work both independently and as member of a team.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Biology, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or related.
Excellent verbal, interpersonal and written communication skills, and the ability to think critically.
Physically capable of lifting 40 lbs., using ladders, and working at elevated heights in accordance with safety standards.
U.S. citizenship required per federal contract.
MUST BE ABLE TO PASS an EPA background check to obtain access to US federal property.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in a paperless laboratory environment.
Prior laboratory bench-level experience using EPA-approved methodologies.
Prior experience with ICP-OES (Inductively Coupled Plasma Optical Emission Spectroscopy) or ICP-MS (Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry)
Sample preparation experience using EPA methodologies such as acid digestion using SW846 methods
Excellent verbal, interpersonal and written communication skills, and the ability to think critically.
Sample preparation using SW846 methods for TCLP and in vitro bioaccessibility and experience with Cal WET.
Recent “hands on” experience with the following instrumentation and associated sample preparation: CVAA (Cold Vapor Atomic Absorption), TDAA (Thermal Desorption Atomic Adsorption), IC (Ion Chromatography), TOC (Total Organic Carbon), FIA (Flow Injection Analysis).
Experience in laboratories accredited for environmental analyses (e.g., TNI or NELAC, state programs).
Experience working at Federal facilities.
Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS’s), knowledge of Promium’s Element LIMS is a plus.

Bot and Third-Party Applications

Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Work Authorization and Sponsorship
All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 

Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  

Pay Range
- There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.

jobs.title: Senior Agrochemical Regulatory Affairs Consultant
jobs.description:
Job Description

Inviting bright minds

Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? We work to create a sustainable future and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people around the world. Ramboll Health Science Spearhead has approx. 360 bright minds globally and you can become one of them in our Australia team contributing to our continued success.

You will join our Environment and Health Business Unit

As our new Senior Consultant, you will have experience and be a subject matter expert in Agrochemical regulations in Australia (APVMA) and New Zealand (EPA and ACVM). You will bring the ability to organize, coordinate and communicate across an interdisciplinary team, engaging externally with technical professionals, and regulatory agencies. You will provide strategic expertise and support the preparation of regulatory submissions for a variety of agrochemical related products in the region. A strong customer service ethic and ability to multitask is vital for this role. You will present a positive “can-do” attitude and be a self-starter within a team of dedicated professionals.

This is a unique opportunity to have a role within the Ramboll Health Science Spearhead to help drive the growth of the agrochemical consulting business in Australia, working with our international team of regulatory and technical experts, while advancing your skills and consulting career. Reporting to the Principal, Health Sciences in Australia your role would be based at one of Ramboll’s Australian Offices.

Your key tasks and responsibility will be:

Support the execution of Product Stewardship and Safety projects with a focus on Australian and New Zealand plant protection registrations
Act as project manager for interdisciplinary agrochemical regulatory projects
Responsible for strategic guidance and translating complex scientific information into regulator-ready submissions.
Advise clients on existing as well as upcoming regulatory obligations (in the fields of environmental, health & safety-related topics)
Developing strategies, market analysis and helping to expand and drive the growth of Ramboll’s agrochemical business in the region.
Active in business development, meeting clients and attending appropriate conferences and seminars to increase Ramboll’s visibility in the region.

Your starting point for constant growth

From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional developments so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:

Ability to provide strategic advice and determine practical compliance solutions to meet our clients’ commercial aims for their agricultural related products.
Experience leading multi-faceted teams on projects, producing a high-quality work product, on time and within budget
Ability to guide clients through registrations, variations, and label/claims strategies, helping to prepare compliance advice, application dossiers and data-gap analyses.
Staying current with changes in regulatory landscape affecting Ramboll’s clients and maintaining contacts and relationships with regulatory authorities.
Proficiency assessing the impact of new regional regulations on the business and participates in actions to assist our clients in dealing with the implementation of these new regulations.
Strong team player and customer-oriented approach.

Qualifications

Desired skills/experience

A minimum of 7 years’ industry or consulting experience with plant protection product registration in Australia and New Zealand
Scientific background preferably with a degree or higher in agriculture, veterinary medicine, chemistry, biology or a related discipline
Ability to handle multiple tasks and work streams in a fast-paced environment while maintaining outstanding attention to detail and quality of deliverables
Experience/comfort with working in a virtual team with stakeholders across geographies
Ability to support internal and external clients with both technical and strategic consulting services
Experience in business development would be advantageous
Strong written and oral communication skills
Good presentation skills and business sense
Demonstrated problem-solving skills
Possess a drive and personal initiative to keep learning and improving in the chosen field.

Additional Information

Welcome to our Environment & Health division

Ramboll develops innovative, scientifically sound solutions that help increase livability by reducing pollution and restoring natural environments. One of the world’s leading environmental and health consultancies, our bright minds are trusted by clients to manage their most challenging environmental, health and social issues.

Ramboll in Asia Pacific

Ramboll has close to 500 experts working across more than 10 offices in Asia Pacific. We are present in Australia, China, Hong Kong SAR, Malaysia, India, Japan, South Korea and Singapore. Our experts are applying their passion to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy and Architecture &, Landscape. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in Asia Pacific

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in Asia Pacific has close to 500 people working across ten offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Architecture & Landscape.

Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: EOI - Engineers | Technicians | Project Managers | Environmental Scientists
jobs.description:
Job Description

Expression of Interest - Engineers | Technicians | Project Managers | Environmental Scientists

Bring your expertise. Build something meaningful in Bundaberg.

Are you an experienced technical or project professional looking for an opportunity to combine meaningful project work with strong client relationships, business development and the potential to grow your leadership career?

GHD is seeking Expressions of Interest
from experienced professionals interested in joining our Bundaberg
team and leading our growth and presence across the Wide Bay region.

We’re deliberately keeping our search broad. Your project management or technical background could be in transport, civil, water, structural, electrical, environment or another technical discipline. What matters most is your ability to bring strong consulting experience, work closely with clients and contribute to both project delivery and business growth.

Build your career, and a great life, in Bundaberg

If you’ve been thinking about swapping the pace of a major city for a regional lifestyle without stepping back from your career, Bundaberg offers the opportunity to do both.

With the coast on your doorstep, a relaxed regional lifestyle and easy access to destinations such as Bargara and the Southern Great Barrier Reef, Bundaberg offers a different way to build your career. Whether you’re already based in Queensland or considering a move from interstate, it’s an opportunity to enjoy the benefits of regional living while continuing to develop your career with a global professional services company.

What could your opportunity look like?

Depending on your experience and background, you could join us as an Engineer, Technician, Project Manager or Environmental Scientist
.

We’re particularly interested in people who enjoy combining hands-on project delivery with building trusted client relationships, identifying opportunities and growing the business.

You may already be an established senior professional, or you may be ready to broaden your influence, take on greater client and commercial responsibility and continue developing towards future leadership opportunities.

This opportunity isn’t defined by a single technical discipline. We’re looking for the right capability, consulting mindset and client orientation to complement our Bundaberg team and contribute to our continued growth across the region.

What You’ll Bring

We’d like to hear from you if you bring:

5 plus years’ experience in consulting, technical delivery or project management
A background in engineering, environment, project management or another relevant technical discipline
Strong client-facing and relationship-building capability
A commercial mindset and an interest in identifying and developing opportunities
The ability and willingness to contribute directly to project delivery
A collaborative approach and the ability to work across disciplines, projects and locations
An interest in contributing to the continued growth of our Bundaberg business
The ambition to continue developing your career and potentially move into broader leadership over time
Relevant professional accreditation for your discipline, such as RPEQ and/or CPEng, or working towards attaining accreditation where applicable

You don’t need to already know the Queensland market. We’re interested in professionals who bring the right consulting and client-focused approach, valuable experience and a willingness to collaborate with colleagues who have strong local market knowledge.

Why GHD?

At GHD, you’ll have the opportunity to combine your technical expertise, project experience and client relationships while being connected to a broader multidisciplinary business. This isn’t about fitting into a narrowly defined role. We’re interested in what you could bring to Bundaberg.

Whether you’re an experienced engineer, project manager, technical specialist or consultant looking for greater influence, broader client exposure and an opportunity to contribute to regional growth, we’d like to hear from you.

Interested?
Register your interest and start a conversation with us about what your career with GHD in Bundaberg could look like. https://www.bundabergregion.org/

GHD is an equal opportunity employer, and we want everyone to be able to fully participate in our recruitment process. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and people of all identities.

GHD embraces a range of flexible work practices to create a work environment focused on well-being, flexibility and productivity where our people can thrive.

We respectfully ask that no agency resumes be presented at this stage.

About Us

Come together and make a meaningful impact.

We bring our people together to create something bigger and solve some of the world's most complex problems. Come and experience the power of commitment and see strategy and ideas come to life when you join GHD.

Let's drive real change.

Our Pledge to You

At GHD, we don’t just believe in the power of commitment, we live and breathe it every day.

That’s why we pledge to empower our people to make a positive impact. Combining our deep technical expertise with the capabilities of our clients and partners, we respond to some of the most complex challenges facing our planet today.

See where your commitment could take you.

That’s the #PowerOfCommitment

Who We Are

GHD is a global professional services company that leads through engineering, architecture, and construction expertise. We are an employee-owned company with over 11,000 diverse and skilled individuals, across more than 200 offices spanning five continents.

The Power of Commitment is our brand promise. It’s what makes us different. We are bound to our stated vision and determination to address humanity’s most urgent needs: to make water, energy and urbanisation sustainable for generations to come.

Associate

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Civil Engineering, Industrial Machinery Manufacturing, and Environmental Services
